title: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27): Date methods behavior on blank Date and DataTime fields when retrieving date data in queries
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 2 (BC27) changes how date methods return values for blank Date and DateTime fields in queries. Starting with BC27, blank dates return 0 for day, month, and year instead of 1, 1, and 1753 as in earlier versions.
key_points: Setting the Method property on a query column to Day, Month or Year returns only that part of a date
BC stores a blank date internally as 0D, while SQL Server stores it as 01-01-1753
In BC26 and earlier, a blank date returns 1, 1 and 1753 for day, month and year
From BC27 onward, a blank date returns 0 for day, month and year
The example query over Purchase Header, Purchase Line and Item uses these methods on the Order Date field

quotes.text: In Business Central, a blank date is represented internally as 0D. In SQL Server, a blank date is 01-01-1753.
quotes.why_it_matters: Understanding the internal representation of blank dates is essential for predicting how date methods behave across versions.

quotes.text: The values that date methods return for blank fields differ by product version.
quotes.why_it_matters: This warning signals a breaking change that requires developers to test and potentially update query logic when upgrading to BC27.
